Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.

- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    # Installation method: "binary" (default). You can extend to "package" if you manage a repo.
    otel_install_method: "binary"

    # OpenTelemetry Collector distribution and version
    otel_distribution: "contrib"          # "contrib" or "core"
    otel_version: "0.101.0"               # Override for desired pinned version

    # Export target configuration
    otlp_endpoint: "otlp.example.com:4317"  # Remote OTLP gRPC endpoint
    otlp_headers: {}                        # e.g. {"authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"}
    otlp_tls_insecure: false                # true to skip TLS verification (not recommended)
    otlp_ca_file: ""                        # path to custom CA cert on host if needed, else empty
    otlp_compression: "gzip"                # "none" or "gzip"

    # Service hardening and runtime
    otel_user: "otelcol"
    otel_group: "otelcol"
    otel_open_port: 4317

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Map architecture for OpenTelemetry release assets
      set_fact:
        otel_arch_map:
          x86_64: amd64
          amd64: amd64
          aarch64: arm64
          arm64: arm64

    - name: Assert supported architecture
      assert:
        that:
          - ansible_architecture in otel_arch_map
        fail_msg: "Unsupported architecture {{ ansible_architecture }}. Supported: x86_64/amd64, aarch64/arm64."
        success_msg: "Architecture {{ ansible_architecture }} supported."

    - name: Set common path facts based on distribution
      set_fact:
        otel_name: "otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}"
        otel_arch: "{{ otel_arch_map[ansible_architecture] }}"
        otel_conf_dir: "/etc/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}"
        otel_data_dir: "/var/lib/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}"
        otel_runtime_dir: "/run/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}"
        otel_bin_path: "/usr/local/bin/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}"
        otel_env_file: "/etc/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}.env"
        otel_service_name: "otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}"
        otel_tarball_name: "otelcol-{{ otel_distribution }}_{{ otel_version }}_linux_{{ otel_arch }}.tar.gz"
        otel_release_base: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otel_version }}"
        otel_checksums_file: "otelcol-{{ otel_distribution }}_{{ otel_version }}_checksums.txt"
        otel_version_file: "/etc/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}/.version"

  tasks:
    - name: Create group for otelcol
      group:
        name: "{{ otel_group }}"
        system: true

    - name: Create user for otelcol
      user:
        name: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        create_home: false

    - name: Create configuration directory
      file:
        path: "{{ otel_conf_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0750"

    - name: Create data directory
      file:
        path: "{{ otel_data_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0750"

    - name: Ensure runtime directory exists (systemd RuntimeDirectory alternative for SELinux/strict systems)
      file:
        path: "{{ otel_runtime_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0750"

    - name: Read current installed collector version (if any)
      slurp:
        src: "{{ otel_version_file }}"
      register: otel_installed_version_file
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Set current installed version fact
      set_fact:
        otel_installed_version: "{{ (otel_installed_version_file['content'] | b64decode).strip() if otel_installed_version_file is defined and otel_installed_version_file['content'] is defined else '' }}"

    - name: Determine if installation/update is needed
      set_fact:
        otel_install_needed: "{{ (otel_install_method == 'binary') and (otel_installed_version != otel_version) }}"

    - name: Download checksums file
      get_url:
        url: "{{ otel_release_base }}/{{ otel_checksums_file }}"
        dest: "/tmp/{{ otel_checksums_file }}"
        mode: "0644"
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Extract expected SHA256 from checksums file
      command: "awk '/{{ otel_tarball_name | regex_escape }}/ {print $1}' /tmp/{{ otel_checksums_file }}"
      register: otel_expected_sha256
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: otel_expected_sha256.stdout == ""
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Download OpenTelemetry Collector tarball
      get_url:
        url: "{{ otel_release_base }}/{{ otel_tarball_name }}"
        dest: "/tmp/{{ otel_tarball_name }}"
        mode: "0644"
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Compute SHA256 of downloaded tarball
      command: "sha256sum /tmp/{{ otel_tarball_name }}"
      register: otel_actual_sha256
      changed_when: false
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Verify tarball checksum
      assert:
        that:
          - (otel_actual_sha256.stdout.split()[0]) == (otel_expected_sha256.stdout.strip())
        fail_msg: "Checksum verification failed for {{ otel_tarball_name }}"
        success_msg: "Checksum verification passed for {{ otel_tarball_name }}"
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Create temporary extraction directory
      tempfile:
        state: directory
        suffix: otelcol
      register: otel_tmp_dir
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Unpack OpenTelemetry Collector tarball
      unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/{{ otel_tarball_name }}"
        dest: "{{ otel_tmp_dir.path }}"
        remote_src: true
        extra_opts:
          - --no-same-owner
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Install OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      copy:
        src: "{{ otel_tmp_dir.path }}/{{ otel_name }}"
        dest: "{{ otel_bin_path }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0755"
        remote_src: true
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Cleanup temporary artifacts
      file:
        path: "{{ item }}"
        state: absent
      with_items:
        - "/tmp/{{ otel_tarball_name }}"
        - "/tmp/{{ otel_checksums_file }}"
        - "{{ otel_tmp_dir.path | default('') }}"
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Record installed version
      copy:
        dest: "{{ otel_version_file }}"
        content: "{{ otel_version }}\n"
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0640"
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Write OpenTelemetry Collector environment file
      copy:
        dest: "{{ otel_env_file }}"
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0640"
        content: |
          # Environment for {{ otel_service_name }}
          # Reserved for future use (e.g., proxy settings, endpoint via env override)
          # Example:
          # HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy.internal:3128
          # HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.internal:3128

    - name: Render OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
      copy:
        dest: "{{ otel_conf_dir }}/config.yaml"
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0640"
        content: |
          receivers:
            otlp:
              protocols:
                grpc:
                  endpoint: "0.0.0.0:{{ otel_open_port }}"

          exporters:
            otlp:
              endpoint: "{{ otlp_endpoint }}"
              tls:
                insecure: {{ otlp_tls_insecure | bool }}
              {% if otlp_ca_file | length > 0 %}
                ca_file: "{{ otlp_ca_file }}"
              {% endif %}
              compression: "{{ otlp_compression }}"
              sending_queue:
                enabled: true
                num_consumers: 4
                queue_size: 10000
              retry_on_failure:
                enabled: true
                initial_interval: 1s
                max_interval: 30s
                max_elapsed_time: 300s
              {% if otlp_headers | length > 0 %}
              headers:
              {% for k, v in otlp_headers.items() %}
                {{ k }}: "{{ v }}"
              {% endfor %}
              {% endif %}

          processors:
            memory_limiter:
              check_interval: 2s
              limit_percentage: 75
              spike_limit_percentage: 15
            batch:
              send_batch_max_size: 8192
              send_batch_size: 2048
              timeout: 2s

          extensions:
            health_check:
              endpoint: "127.0.0.1:13133"
            pprof:
              endpoint: "127.0.0.1:1777"
            zpages:
              endpoint: "127.0.0.1:55679"

          service:
            extensions: [health_check, pprof, zpages]
            pipelines:
              traces:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
              metrics:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
              logs:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
                exporters: [otlp]

    - name: Create systemd unit file for OpenTelemetry Collector
      copy:
        dest: "/etc/systemd/system/{{ otel_service_name }}.service"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=OpenTelemetry Collector ({{ otel_distribution }})
          Documentation=https://opentelemetry.io/docs/collector/
          Wants=network-online.target
          After=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ otel_user }}
          Group={{ otel_group }}
          EnvironmentFile=-{{ otel_env_file }}
          ExecStart={{ otel_bin_path }} --config={{ otel_conf_dir }}/config.yaml
          ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5s
          # Security hardening
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          PrivateTmp=true
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectHome=true
          ProtectControlGroups=true
          ProtectKernelTunables=true
          ProtectKernelModules=true
          RestrictRealtime=true
          RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
          LockPersonality=true
          MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
          AmbientCapabilities=
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          LimitNOFILE=65536
          RuntimeDirectory={{ otel_service_name }}
          RuntimeDirectoryMode=0750
          ReadWritePaths={{ otel_conf_dir }} {{ otel_data_dir }}

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Enable and start OpenTelemetry Collector
      systemd:
        name: "{{ otel_service_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started

    - name: Set common path facts based on distribution
      set_fact:
        otel_name: "otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}"
        otel_arch: "{{ otel_arch_map[ansible_architecture] }}"
        otel_conf_dir: "/etc/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}"
        otel_data_dir: "/var/lib/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}"
        otel_runtime_dir: "/run/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}"
        otel_bin_path: "/usr/local/bin/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}"
        otel_env_file: "/etc/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}.env"
        otel_service_name: "otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}"
        otel_tarball_name: "otelcol-{{ otel_distribution }}_{{ otel_version }}_linux_{{ otel_arch }}.tar.gz"
        otel_release_base: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otel_version }}"
        otel_checksums_file: "otelcol-{{ otel_distribution }}_{{ otel_version }}_checksums.txt"
        otel_version_file: "/etc/otelcol{{ '-contrib' if otel_distribution == 'contrib' else '' }}/.version"

  tasks:
    - name: Create group for otelcol
      group:
        name: "{{ otel_group }}"
        system: true

    - name: Create user for otelcol
      user:
        name: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        create_home: false

    - name: Create configuration directory
      file:
        path: "{{ otel_conf_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0750"

    - name: Create data directory
      file:
        path: "{{ otel_data_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0750"

    - name: Ensure runtime directory exists (systemd RuntimeDirectory alternative for SELinux/strict systems)
      file:
        path: "{{ otel_runtime_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0750"

    - name: Read current installed collector version (if any)
      slurp:
        src: "{{ otel_version_file }}"
      register: otel_installed_version_file
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Set current installed version fact
      set_fact:
        otel_installed_version: "{{ (otel_installed_version_file['content'] | b64decode).strip() if otel_installed_version_file is defined and otel_installed_version_file['content'] is defined else '' }}"

    - name: Determine if installation/update is needed
      set_fact:
        otel_install_needed: "{{ (otel_install_method == 'binary') and (otel_installed_version != otel_version) }}"

    - name: Download checksums file
      get_url:
        url: "{{ otel_release_base }}/{{ otel_checksums_file }}"
        dest: "/tmp/{{ otel_checksums_file }}"
        mode: "0644"
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Extract expected SHA256 from checksums file
      command: "awk '/{{ otel_tarball_name | regex_escape }}/ {print $1}' /tmp/{{ otel_checksums_file }}"
      register: otel_expected_sha256
      changed_when: false
      failed_when: otel_expected_sha256.stdout == ""
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Download OpenTelemetry Collector tarball
      get_url:
        url: "{{ otel_release_base }}/{{ otel_tarball_name }}"
        dest: "/tmp/{{ otel_tarball_name }}"
        mode: "0644"
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Compute SHA256 of downloaded tarball
      command: "sha256sum /tmp/{{ otel_tarball_name }}"
      register: otel_actual_sha256
      changed_when: false
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Verify tarball checksum
      assert:
        that:
          - (otel_actual_sha256.stdout.split()[0]) == (otel_expected_sha256.stdout.strip())
        fail_msg: "Checksum verification failed for {{ otel_tarball_name }}"
        success_msg: "Checksum verification passed for {{ otel_tarball_name }}"
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Create temporary extraction directory
      tempfile:
        state: directory
        suffix: otelcol
      register: otel_tmp_dir
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Unpack OpenTelemetry Collector tarball
      unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/{{ otel_tarball_name }}"
        dest: "{{ otel_tmp_dir.path }}"
        remote_src: true
        extra_opts:
          - --no-same-owner
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Install OpenTelemetry Collector binary
      copy:
        src: "{{ otel_tmp_dir.path }}/{{ otel_name }}"
        dest: "{{ otel_bin_path }}"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0755"
        remote_src: true
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Cleanup temporary artifacts
      file:
        path: "{{ item }}"
        state: absent
      with_items:
        - "/tmp/{{ otel_tarball_name }}"
        - "/tmp/{{ otel_checksums_file }}"
        - "{{ otel_tmp_dir.path | default('') }}"
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Record installed version
      copy:
        dest: "{{ otel_version_file }}"
        content: "{{ otel_version }}\n"
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0640"
      when: otel_install_needed

    - name: Write OpenTelemetry Collector environment file
      copy:
        dest: "{{ otel_env_file }}"
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0640"
        content: |
          # Environment for {{ otel_service_name }}
          # Reserved for future use (e.g., proxy settings, endpoint via env override)
          # Example:
          # HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy.internal:3128
          # HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.internal:3128

    - name: Render OpenTelemetry Collector configuration
      copy:
        dest: "{{ otel_conf_dir }}/config.yaml"
        owner: "{{ otel_user }}"
        group: "{{ otel_group }}"
        mode: "0640"
        content: |
          receivers:
            otlp:
              protocols:
                grpc:
                  endpoint: "0.0.0.0:{{ otel_open_port }}"

          exporters:
            otlp:
              endpoint: "{{ otlp_endpoint }}"
              tls:
                insecure: {{ otlp_tls_insecure | bool }}
              {% if otlp_ca_file | length > 0 %}
                ca_file: "{{ otlp_ca_file }}"
              {% endif %}
              compression: "{{ otlp_compression }}"
              sending_queue:
                enabled: true
                num_consumers: 4
                queue_size: 10000
              retry_on_failure:
                enabled: true
                initial_interval: 1s
                max_interval: 30s
                max_elapsed_time: 300s
              {% if otlp_headers | length > 0 %}
              headers:
              {% for k, v in otlp_headers.items() %}
                {{ k }}: "{{ v }}"
              {% endfor %}
              {% endif %}

          processors:
            memory_limiter:
              check_interval: 2s
              limit_percentage: 75
              spike_limit_percentage: 15
            batch:
              send_batch_max_size: 8192
              send_batch_size: 2048
              timeout: 2s

          extensions:
            health_check:
              endpoint: "127.0.0.1:13133"
            pprof:
              endpoint: "127.0.0.1:1777"
            zpages:
              endpoint: "127.0.0.1:55679"

          service:
            extensions: [health_check, pprof, zpages]
            pipelines:
              traces:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
              metrics:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
              logs:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
                exporters: [otlp]

    - name: Create systemd unit file for OpenTelemetry Collector
      copy:
        dest: "/etc/systemd/system/{{ otel_service_name }}.service"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=OpenTelemetry Collector ({{ otel_distribution }})
          Documentation=https://opentelemetry.io/docs/collector/
          Wants=network-online.target
          After=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ otel_user }}
          Group={{ otel_group }}
          EnvironmentFile=-{{ otel_env_file }}
          ExecStart={{ otel_bin_path }} --config={{ otel_conf_dir }}/config.yaml
          ExecReload=/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5s
          # Security hardening
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          PrivateTmp=true
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectHome=true
          ProtectControlGroups=true
          ProtectKernelTunables=true
          ProtectKernelModules=true
          RestrictRealtime=true
          RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
          LockPersonality=true
          MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
          AmbientCapabilities=
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          LimitNOFILE=65536
          RuntimeDirectory={{ otel_service_name }}
          RuntimeDirectoryMode=0750
          ReadWritePaths={{ otel_conf_dir }} {{ otel_data_dir }}

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Enable and start OpenTelemetry Collector
      systemd:
        name: "{{ otel_service_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started
